backup-recovery.note: PDF proof: centred byline, ragged-right paragraphs with a note, Crimson Pro default for new fiction designs, shared margin units; EPUB requests hyphenation; export report and Word exchange panels reordered. Salvage changes only pin a test design's font. The compatibility guide records the typography defaults.

editor.no_impact: Clipboard validation now parses in a detached document with the same supported paste output. Main-window navigation and Android CSP hardening add no editor controls or manuscript changes.
editor.note: Clipboard validation now parses in a detached document with the same supported paste output. Main-window navigation and Android CSP hardening add no editor controls or manuscript changes.

encryption.no_impact: Naming the existing Unix credential dependency directly changes no archive encryption, staging, keys, or stored data. Existing encryption and compatibility guidance remains applicable.
encryption.note: Naming the existing Unix credential dependency directly changes no archive encryption, staging, keys, or stored data. Existing encryption and compatibility guidance remains applicable.

maintenance.no_impact: The instance guard checks its directory and peer and bounds request reads. Its library scope, CLI commands, stored books, and contributor check commands are unchanged, so existing maintenance and compatibility guidance remains applicable.
maintenance.note: The instance guard checks its directory and peer and bounds request reads. Its library scope, CLI commands, stored books, and contributor check commands are unchanged, so existing maintenance and compatibility guidance remains applicable.

native-packaging.no_impact: Unix instance sockets use a checked private fallback directory and same-user peer credentials, with bounded reads. Build and installation steps are unchanged; guard failures still report to stderr and allow startup. Existing packaging documentation remains applicable.
native-packaging.note: Unix instance sockets use a checked private fallback directory and same-user peer credentials, with bounded reads. Build and installation steps are unchanged; guard failures still report to stderr and allow startup. Existing packaging documentation remains applicable.
